ditto-transform.name: Transform
ditto-transform.description: Bond skill: turns into a copy of its foe and strikes with its power (Power 85, Attack).

ditto-envelop.name: Envelop
ditto-envelop.description: Bond skill: smothers a foe in goo (Power 70), engaging it; Slow 2 turns.

ditto-shapeshift-dash.name: Shapeshift Dash
ditto-shapeshift-dash.description: Bond skill: streams up to 2 hexes into a foe (Power 60) and engages it.

ditto-copycat-instinct.name: Copycat Instinct
ditto-copycat-instinct.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

ditto-gooey-grip.name: Gooey Grip
ditto-gooey-grip.description: Foes it hits from an adjacent hex become Slow for 1 turn.

ditto-puddle-regrowth.name: Puddle Regrowth
ditto-puddle-regrowth.description: Heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

ditto-elastic-form.name: Elastic Form
ditto-elastic-form.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

ditto-studied-foe.name: Studied Foe
ditto-studied-foe.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

ditto-perfect-copy.name: Perfect Copy
ditto-perfect-copy.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

ditto-squishy.name: Squishy
ditto-squishy.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

ditto-shape-memory.name: Shape Memory
ditto-shape-memory.description: Knocking out a foe resets its skill cooldowns.

ditto-sticky-body.name: Sticky Body
ditto-sticky-body.description: Foes it engages always draw its free strike when leaving, even if they disengage.

ditto-imposter.name: Imposter
ditto-imposter.description: Capstone. +1 Attack for the battle per knockout (max +3); statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

ditto-living-mirror.name: Living Mirror
ditto-living-mirror.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage; foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 8 damage.
